stories.title: Oranje is niet echt goed tegen Servië, maar wel leuk om te zien (2-1)

en.title: Orange not really good against Serbia, but nice to watch (2-1)
en.summary: The Netherlands defeated Serbia 2-1 in a match that was entertaining to observe, though the Dutch team's performance was not particularly strong.

stories.title: Oranje boekt dankzij goal Zirkzee moeizame zege op Servië in Nations League

en.title: Orange books difficult victory over Serbia thanks to Zirkzee goal in Nations League
en.summary: The Dutch national team won 2-1 against Serbia in a Nations League match in Eindhoven under coach Xavi Hernández, with Zirkzee scoring in the narrow victory.

stories.title: Spaanse politie begint met ontruimen laatste grote migrantenkamp in Ceuta, eerste fase afgerond zonder incidenten

en.title: Spanish police begins evacuation of last major migrant camp in Ceuta, first phase completed without incidents
en.summary: Spanish authorities began clearing a migrant camp on El Trampolín beach in Ceuta where approximately 3,000 people had lived in poor conditions for over two months.

stories.title: Honderden Franse scholen blijven na het weekend (gedeeltelijk) dicht, nieuwe protesten gepland

en.title: Hundreds of French schools remain (partially) closed after the weekend, new protests planned
en.summary: Between 400 and 500 schools across France are closed or partially closed because safety for students and staff cannot be guaranteed, with further protests scheduled.

stories.title: Honderden Franse scholen morgen dicht uit vrees voor nieuwe gewelddadige protesten

en.title: Hundreds of French schools to close tomorrow amid fears of new violent protests
en.summary: Around 500 French schools will close or operate with reduced capacity due to unrest surrounding student protests. Thousands of students, teachers, and others are demonstrating nationwide against educational issues including building maintenance backlogs, teacher shortages, and overcrowded classrooms.

stories.title: Politie ontruimt grootste migrantenkamp op Ceuta vlak voor komst koningspaar

en.title: Police evacuate largest migrant camp in Ceuta ahead of royal visit
en.summary: Spanish police began evacuating the largest migrant camp in Ceuta, relocating approximately 3,000 people. The operation occurs one week before the Spanish royal couple's scheduled visit to the Spanish exclave.

stories.title: Politie Spanje ontruimt migrantenkamp op strand in Ceuta

en.title: Spanish police evacuate migrant camp on beach in Ceuta
en.summary: Spanish police began evacuating a migrant camp from El Trampolín beach in Ceuta with 350 officers and military police deployed. The operation proceeded without incidents, with additional measures including boats and divers positioned to prevent escapes by sea.

stories.title: Franse onderwijsminister: maandag opnieuw 400 scholen dicht

en.title: French education minister: 400 schools closed again Monday
en.summary: France's education minister announced that approximately 400 schools will be closed again on Monday.

stories.title: Verstappen viert zege met vader: 'Start seizoen voor hem ook niet leuk om te zien'

en.title: Verstappen celebrates victory with father: 'Season start not pleasant for him to see either'
en.summary: Max Verstappen won his first Grand Prix in Malaysia using Red Bull's newly developed engine and celebrated the milestone with his father. The four-time world champion described the achievement as particularly meaningful.

stories.title: Honderden scholen in Frankrijk maandag dicht uit angst voor geweld

en.title: Hundreds of schools in France closed Monday over violence fears
en.summary: Between four hundred and five hundred secondary schools in France remained closed or operated with limited capacity on Monday following violent protests at educational institutions during the previous week.

stories.title: Regen en computerchaos kunnen dominante Verstappen niet afhouden van eerste zege in 2026

en.title: Rain and computer chaos cannot stop dominant Verstappen from first victory in 2026
en.summary: Max Verstappen won a grand prix for the first time in ten months at the Malaysia race. Many cars struggled with rainy conditions and engine issues at the start of the race.

stories.title: Gewonden bij brand op camping Gardameer, vakantiegangers helpen brandweer

en.title: Injuries in fire at Lake Garda campground, vacationers assist firefighters
en.summary: A fire at a large Lake Garda campground injured at least twenty people, mostly from carbon monoxide exposure. The fire destroyed approximately twenty caravans and vehicles, with one person in critical condition.
